definition_zh: 底部；底端；最下层；尽头；臀部
definition_en: the lowest part of something, the least important position, or the far end
core_image: 一池清水，视线一直落到池底的石子
scene: 池塘的水很清，站在岸边能看见池底的白色石子。 You can see the stones at the bottom of the pond.
sceneCN: 这里 bottom 是「底部」（第 1 个义项：物体最低的那一面）；句意为你能看见池塘底部的石子。

pos.zh: 名词：底部；底端；最下层；臀部
形容词：最下面的；最低的

derivatives.zh: 由 bottom 加 -less 构成，义为「无底的；深不可测的」
由 bottom 加 -most 构成，义为「最底下的」
由 bottom 与 up 组合而成，义为「自下而上的」

senses.title: The lowest part
senses.definition: the lowest or deepest part of a container, surface or object
senses.definitionCN: 容器、表面或物体最低、最深的部分
senses.example: The keys were at the bottom of the bag.
senses.exampleCN: 钥匙在包的底部。
senses.why: Old English botm meant the ground or the lowest part, and that physical sense is still the centre.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 botm 指地面或最低处，这个身体层面的义项仍是中心。

senses.title: The lowest position
senses.definition: the least important or lowest position in a group or scale
senses.definitionCN: 群体或等级中地位最低、最不重要的位置
senses.example: The team finished at the bottom of the league.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍在联赛中排名垫底。
senses.why: A ladder and a table both have a bottom, so the lowest rank in a group is pictured the same way.
senses.whyCN: 梯子和表格都有底部，于是一个群体中最低的等级也被这样描画。

senses.title: The far end
senses.definition: the far end of a long place, such as a garden, street or page
senses.definitionCN: 狭长地方最远的一端，如花园、街道或页面的末端
senses.example: There is a shed at the bottom of the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 花园尽头有一间小屋。
senses.why: When you look along a long space, its far end sits at the limit of your view, as if at the bottom of the picture.
senses.whyCN: 沿着狭长空间望去，最远的一端落在视野的边界，好像画面底部一样。

senses.title: The part you sit on
senses.definition: the part of the body that you sit on, used in a polite or slightly informal way
senses.definitionCN: 坐着时承重的那部分身体，用于礼貌或略口语的说法
senses.example: The fall hurt his bottom.
senses.exampleCN: 那一跤摔疼了他的屁股。
senses.why: The lowest part of the body took the same word, softened so that it can be said without embarrassment.
senses.whyCN: 身体最低的部分也用了同一个词，语气 softened 之后可以不必尴尬地说出口。

intro.en: Bottom is an old word for the ground and the lowest part of anything, and English extended it to rank and to the body.
intro.cn: bottom 是表示地面与最低处的古词，英语把它扩展到等级与身体。

items.en: Old English botm meant the lowest part, the ground, or the bed of the sea.
items.cn: 古英语 botm 指最低处、地面或海底。

items.en: German Boden and Dutch bodem are relatives, all meaning ground or floor.
items.cn: 德语 Boden 与荷兰语 bodem 是同源词，都表示地面或底部。

items.en: Because a scale is pictured as a vertical stack, the lowest rank became the bottom.
items.cn: 由于等级被想象成竖着堆叠，最低的等级就成了 the bottom。

items.en: The lowest part of the body borrowed the word in a softened way.
items.cn: 身体最低的部分以委婉的方式借用了这个词。

items.en: Today bottom covers the base of things, the lowest rank, the far end of a place and the body part.
items.cn: 今天 bottom 覆盖物体的底部、最低等级、地方尽头与身体部位。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words close in shape; the near-meaning group collects words about bases and ends.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词；近义组收与底部、末端有关的词。

entries.definition: A narrow-necked container for liquid.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「瓶子」，拼写与 bottom 相近。

entries.definition: A small round thing used to fasten clothes or operate a machine.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「纽扣；按钮」，拼写与 bottom 相近。

entries.definition: The season between summer and winter.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「秋天」，读音与 bottom 接近。

entries.definition: The lowest part of something, on which it stands.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「底部；基座」，指物体站立所依的下部。

entries.definition: The lowest part of a hill, page or object.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「底部；下端」，如山坡或页面的底部。

entries.definition: The furthest or last part of something long.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「末端；尽头」，对应 bottom 的尽头义。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded history, the real family, and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的历史、真实词族和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Old English botm meant the ground or the bed of the sea.
normal.cn: 古英语 botm 指地面或海底。

normal.en: German Boden and Dutch bodem are relatives, all meaning ground.
normal.cn: 德语 Boden 与荷兰语 bodem 是同源词，都表示地面。

normal.en: A scale is pictured as a stack, so the lowest rank is the bottom.
normal.cn: 等级被想象成堆叠，所以最低的等级就是 the bottom。

normal.en: It commonly pairs with at, of, line and sea.
normal.cn: 它常与 at、of、line、sea 搭配。

normal.en: Spell b-o-t-t-o-m; the double t keeps the vowel short.
normal.cn: 拼写是 b-o-t-t-o-m，双写的 t 让元音保持短促。

abstract.en: See clear water and white stones resting at the very lowest point: that point is the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象清澈的水与白石静静躺在最低处：那个位置就是 bottom。

abstract.en: Turn the pond into a league table and the lowest row is still the bottom.
abstract.cn: 把池塘换成一览表，最低的那一行仍然是 the bottom。

abstract.en: Say the word and let the stones bring the sense back.
abstract.cn: 先读这个词，再让那些石子把意思带回来。

examples.en: The keys were at the bottom of the bag.
examples.cn: 钥匙在包的底部。

examples.en: The team finished at the bottom of the league.
examples.cn: 这支队伍在联赛中排名垫底。

examples.en: There is a shed at the bottom of the garden.
examples.cn: 花园尽头有一间小屋。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「波腾」——清水一直看到池底的石子：底部

root: bottom 来自古英语 botm，指最低处、地面或海底，德语 Boden 与荷兰语 bodem 是同源词。等级被想象成竖着堆叠，于是最低的等级也叫 the bottom；狭长地方的远端落在视野边界，也被称作 bottom。身体最低的部分则以委婉方式借用了这个词。

sensesIntro.en: All four senses of bottom rest on one picture: the lowest point you can reach, whether in a pond, a ranking, a garden or on the body.
sensesIntro.cn: bottom 的四个义项都立在同一个画面上：你能触到的最低那一点，无论是在池塘里、排名里、花园里，还是在身体上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: clear water with white stones resting at the lowest point
core.cn: 核心意象：清水下白石静静躺在最低处

branches.en: THE BASE: the lowest part of a thing is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 底部线：物体最低的部分是最古老的义项。

branches.en: THE RANK: the lowest place in a scale is pictured as a bottom.
branches.cn: 等级线：等级中最低的位置被想象成底部。

branches.en: THE END: the far end of a long place sits at the edge of sight.
branches.cn: 尽头线：狭长地方的最远端落在视野边缘。

branches.en: THE SEAT: the lowest part of the body borrows the word politely.
branches.cn: 坐处线：身体最低的部分以礼貌方式借用了这个词。

branches.en: THE LOW POINT: physical depth and low rank share one image.
branches.cn: 低点线：物理深度与低等级共享同一幅画面。

intro.en: Bottom is a base noun, so the items below are its endings and the words it joins.
intro.cn: bottom 是基础名词，下面列出的是它的词尾以及与之组合的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin fundus and imus are recorded words for a bottom and the lowest; they are parallels, not the source of bottom.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fundus 与 imus 分别是有记录的「底部」与「最低的」，它们是平行词，不是 bottom 的来源。

items.example: Botm is the recorded Old English form.
items.exampleCN: botm 是有记录的古英语形式。

items.meaning: the salt water of the earth
items.example: It forms the bottom of the sea.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 the bottom of the sea。

items.example: It forms at the bottom of.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 at the bottom of。

definition_zh: 担心；担忧；使担心；焦虑；烦恼
definition_en: to feel anxious about something, to make someone anxious, or the feeling of anxiety itself
core_image: 半夜翻来覆去，同一件事在脑子里绕圈，越绕越紧
scene: 离考试还有三天，她已经把同一页笔记看了五遍，却什么也没记住。 Do not worry; the letter will arrive in a day or two.
sceneCN: 这里 worry 是「担心」（第 1 个义项：对未定之事感到不安）；句意为别担心，信一两天就到。半夜翻来覆去、同一件事在脑子里绕圈，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 worry 加 -ed 构成，义为「担心的；焦虑的」
由 worry 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人担忧的」
由 worrying 加 -ly 构成，义为「令人担忧地」
由 worry 与 wart 拼合，义为「爱操心的人」

senses.title: To feel anxious
senses.definition: to keep turning over something uncertain or unpleasant in the mind
senses.definitionCN: 心里反复想着未定或不好的事
senses.example: Do not worry; the letter will arrive in a day or two.
senses.exampleCN: 别担心，信一两天就到。
senses.why: The oldest meaning is to strangle, and the mind does to a thought what a hand does to a throat.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是勒住，而心对念头做的事，正如手对喉咙做的事。

senses.title: To make someone anxious
senses.definition: to cause another person to feel uneasy by what one does
senses.definitionCN: 因自己的行为让别人感到不安
senses.example: It worries me that she has not called since Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 她周五之后就没来电话，这让我不安。
senses.why: The same grip is now given to another person, so the verb moves from feeling it to causing it.
senses.whyCN: 同一只手现在攥住的是别人，于是动词从「被攥」变为「去攥」。

senses.title: The feeling
senses.definition: the state of being anxious, or a particular thing that causes it
senses.definitionCN: 焦虑的状态，或引起它的一件件具体事
senses.example: Money is the biggest worry for most families this year.
senses.exampleCN: 今年大多数家庭最大的烦恼就是钱。
senses.why: The verb turns into a noun that names both the state and the things that keep it going.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词，既指那种状态，也指不断维持它的那些事。

senses.title: To keep biting at something
senses.definition: of an animal, to bite and shake something again and again
senses.definitionCN: 指动物反复咬住并甩动某物
senses.example: The dog worried the old shoe until the sole came off.
senses.exampleCN: 那只狗把那旧鞋咬来甩去，直到鞋底脱落。
senses.why: This is the oldest visible sense: the throat, the bite, the grip that does not let go.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的可见义：喉咙、咬住、不放的那只手。

intro.en: Worry came from Old English wyrgan, to strangle, and only in modern English did it come to mean mental distress.
intro.cn: worry 来自古英语 wyrgan（勒死），到近代英语才用于表示心里的忧苦。

items.en: wyrgan meant to strangle or to seize by the throat.
items.cn: wyrgan 意为勒死或扼住喉咙。

items.en: The stem appears in other Germanic words for choking and wrestling.
items.cn: 同一词干出现在其他日耳曼语中表示窒息与扭打的词里。

items.en: The meaning moved to seizing and shaking with the teeth, as a dog worries a bone.
items.cn: 词义转向用牙齿咬住甩动，如狗折腾骨头。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the sense spread to the mind: to worry a problem.
items.cn: 十九世纪这层意思扩展到内心：把一个问题反复「咬住」。

items.en: The anxious sense became the main one, and the earlier bite sense survives in descriptions of animals.
items.cn: 忧虑义成了主要义项，早先的咬义仅存于描述动物的文字中。

note.en: The first group holds the forms of the same verb, the second holds other words for anxiety.
note.cn: 第一组收同一动词的各种形态，第二组收其他表示焦虑的词。

entries.definition: Feeling anxious.
Causing anxiety.
Third person singular, or more than one worry.
A feeling of worry about someone or something.
A stronger, often lasting feeling of worry.
To worry in a small, restless way.

normalIntro.en: Worry keeps the stem and changes y to i before endings: worries, worried.
normalIntro.cn: worry 保留词干，在加词尾时把 y 变成 i：worries、worried。

normal.en: After a consonant plus y, the y turns to i before -es and -ed: worried.
normal.cn: 辅音加 y 结尾，接 -es、-ed 时 y 变 i：worried。

normal.en: The present participle adds -ing without a change: worrying.
normal.cn: 现在分词直接加 -ing：worrying。

normal.en: Worry about takes the thing that troubles you, worry over is a more literary variant.
normal.cn: worry about 后接让你发愁的事，worry over 更书面。

normal.en: The verb can take a person as object: it worries me, meaning it makes me anxious.
normal.cn: 这个动词也可以接人作宾语：it worries me，意思是他让我担心。

normal.en: Its old meaning is to strangle, which explains why worry feels like a grip on the chest.
normal.cn: 它的古义是勒住，这解释了担心为何像胸口被攥住。

abstract.en: A thought circling the same night hour after hour.
abstract.cn: 一个念头一夜又一夜地绕圈。

abstract.en: A hand closing, though there is nothing in it.
abstract.cn: 手握紧了，里面却空着。

abstract.en: A page read five times without a single word staying.
abstract.cn: 一页看了五遍，一个字也没留下。

examples.en: Try not to worry about the results.
examples.cn: 尽量别为结果担心。

examples.en: His silence worried everyone at the table.
examples.cn: 他的沉默让桌边所有人都担心起来。

examples.en: Her main worry was how to pay the rent.
examples.cn: 她最大的烦恼是怎么付房租。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我瑞」——心里总觉着不祥的「瑞」兆要出事，于是担心。

root: 古英语 wyrgan（勒死、扼住），中古英语转为「咬住甩动」，近代英语才引申为「心里反复咬住一件事」，即担心。

sensesIntro.en: The throat grip comes first, then the bite that shakes, then the anxious mind, then the anxiety passed to others, and finally the anxiety itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是扼喉，再是咬住甩动，接着是焦灼的心，然后是把焦虑传给别人，最后是焦虑本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thought circling deeper hour after hour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个念头越绕越紧。

branches.en: The anxiety branch: a letter that will surely arrive.
branches.cn: 焦虑分支：信总会到的。

branches.en: The causing branch: silence that makes others uneasy.
branches.cn: 致忧分支：让旁人不安的沉默。

branches.en: The noun branch: rent as the biggest worry.
branches.cn: 名词分支：最大的烦恼是房租。

branches.en: The bite branch: a dog shaking an old shoe.
branches.cn: 咬分支：狗甩旧鞋。

branches.en: The everyday branch: the same word for the feeling and the cause.
branches.cn: 日常分支：感受与来源共用一词。

intro.en: Worry is a bare stem whose y changes to i before endings, and -ing and -ed build its adjectives.
intro.cn: worry 是裸词干，加词尾时 y 变 i，-ing 与 -ed 构成它的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin words below name a close feeling from another tradition.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语；下面的拉丁词从另一传统来指相近的感受。

items.exampleCN: 它解释了 worried 的写法。

definition_zh: 圆的；围绕；一轮；一回合；绕行
definition_en: shaped like a circle, surrounding something, or one stage in a series
core_image: 一张围坐的圆桌
scene: 客人围坐在桌旁。 The guests sat round the table.
sceneCN: 这里 round 是「围绕」（第 2 个义项）；句意：客人围坐在桌旁。

derivatives.zh: 彻底地；严厉地
圆；圆润
圆形的；圆润的
环岛；绕行路线

senses.title: Circle shape
senses.definition: shaped like a circle or a ball
senses.definitionCN: 形状像圆圈或球体
senses.example: They sat at a round table.
senses.exampleCN: 他们坐在一张圆桌旁。
senses.why: The shape has no corners and curves all the way.
senses.whyCN: 这个形状没有角，一路弯曲。

senses.title: Surrounding
senses.definition: on every side of something, or moving in a circle
senses.definitionCN: 在某物的各侧，或沿圆圈移动
senses.example: We walked round the old city wall.
senses.exampleCN: 我们绕着古城墙走了一圈。
senses.why: The circle shape becomes a path around a thing.
senses.whyCN: 圆形变成围绕某物的一条路径。

senses.title: One stage
senses.definition: one stage in a competition or a series of events
senses.definitionCN: 比赛或一系列事件中的一个阶段
senses.example: The team won in the first round.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍在第一轮获胜。
senses.why: Events complete a circle and start again.
senses.whyCN: 事件走完一圈又重新开始。

senses.title: Go around
senses.definition: to move around something or turn a corner
senses.definitionCN: 绕过某物或转过拐角
senses.example: The bus rounded the corner slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 公交车慢慢转过拐角。
senses.why: The verb turns the circle into movement.
senses.whyCN: 动词把圆圈变成移动。

intro.en: Round comes from Latin rotundus, round, through French rond.
intro.cn: round 经法语 rond 源自拉丁语 rotundus，意为圆的。

items.en: Rotundus means round or wheel-like.
items.cn: rotundus 意为圆的、像轮子的。

items.en: Rota means wheel.
items.cn: rota 意为车轮。

items.en: Old French rond keeps the circular sense.
items.cn: 古法语 rond 保留圆形含义。

items.en: English round covers shape, path, and stage.
items.cn: 英语 round 涵盖形状、路径与阶段。

items.en: Round trip and round table become common phrases.
items.cn: round trip 与 round table 成为常用短语。

note.en: Round is the shape; around is the position.
note.cn: round 多指形状，around 多指位置。

entries.definition: on every side of
curved rather than sharp
completely or firmly
shaped like a circle
on every side
to move around a corner

normalIntro.en: Round shapes make paths, turns, and stages.
normalIntro.cn: 圆的形状衍生出路径、转弯与轮次。

normal.en: They bought a round table for the kitchen.
normal.cn: 他们为厨房买了一张圆桌。

normal.en: The moon is round tonight.
normal.cn: 今晚的月亮是圆的。

normal.en: The children ran round the garden.
normal.cn: 孩子们绕着花园跑。

normal.en: She passed the first round easily.
normal.cn: 她轻松通过了第一轮。

normal.en: The car rounded the bend at speed.
normal.cn: 汽车高速转过弯道。

abstract.en: Picture a round table with chairs all around.
abstract.cn: 想象一张四周摆满椅子的圆桌。

abstract.en: Imagine a path circling a small garden.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绕着花园的小路。

abstract.en: Think of a clock hand sweeping in a circle.
abstract.cn: 想象钟表指针画出一圈。

examples.en: The pond is perfectly round.
examples.cn: 这个池塘圆得很规整。

examples.en: We traveled round the island by bus.
examples.cn: 我们乘巴士环岛旅行。

examples.en: The final round starts at noon.
examples.cn: 决赛轮中午开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「round」像「绕」——绕成一圈就是圆的；沿着圈走就是围绕；走完一圈就是一轮。

root: 拉丁语 rotundus（圆的）与 rota（轮）→ 法语 rond → round，核心义「绕成一圈的形状与路径」。

sensesIntro.en: Round means circular, surrounding, one stage in a series, or to go around.
sensesIntro.cn: round 意为圆形的、围绕的、一轮一回合，或绕行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round table with chairs around it.
core.cn: 核心意象：四周摆着椅子的圆桌。

branches.en: The circular shape is the first sense.
branches.cn: 圆形是第一个义项。

branches.en: The circle becomes a path around things.
branches.cn: 圆圈变成绕行路径。

branches.en: A full circle of events is one round.
branches.cn: 事件走完一圈就是一轮。

branches.en: The verb turns the shape into motion.
branches.cn: 动词把形状变成运动。

branches.en: Both follow a circular order.
branches.cn: 两者都遵循循环顺序。

intro.en: Round comes from Latin rotundus and French rond.
intro.cn: round 来自拉丁语 rotundus 与法语 rond。

latinIntro.en: Rota and rotundus supply the wheel image.
latinIntro.cn: rota 与 rotundus 提供车轮意象。

items.exampleCN: roundabout 由 round 与 about 组合。

latinEntries.example: Rotundus is the source of round.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rotundus 是 round 的来源。

definition_zh: 面试；采访；面谈
definition_en: a meeting in which someone is asked questions, either to judge them for a job or to get their views for the public
core_image: 两张椅子面对面摆着，中间只有一台录音机
scene: 写字楼的小间里，桌子两侧各坐一人，桌上摊着一份简历和一支笔。 The interview lasted barely twenty minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 interview 是「面试」（第 1 个义项：为判断是否录用而进行的问答），句意为那场面试只持续了不到二十分钟。画面里的物件：简历、录音笔、两张椅子。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「面试官；采访者」
由本词加 -ee 构成，义为「受面试者；受访者」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「面试工作；访谈方法」

senses.title: Questions for a job
senses.definition: a formal meeting where an employer asks a candidate questions to judge their suitability
senses.definitionCN: 雇主向候选人提问以判断其是否适合的正式会面
senses.example: Her interview at the bank is on Friday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她在银行的面试定在周五上午。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between and videre means to see, so the word first meant seeing each other face to face.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，videre 意为「看见」，所以本义是「彼此见面」。

senses.title: Questions for the public
senses.definition: a conversation in which a journalist asks someone questions for print or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 记者为报刊或广播电视向某人提问的对谈
senses.example: The singer gave a long interview about her new record.
senses.exampleCN: 这位歌手就新专辑接受了一次长采访。
senses.why: Journalism reused the face-to-face meeting and turned it into published words.
senses.whyCN: 新闻业借用这种面对面见面，把它变成发表出来的文字。

senses.title: The verb of asking
senses.definition: to ask someone questions in such a meeting, or to be asked them
senses.definitionCN: 在此类会面中向某人提问，或接受提问
senses.example: They interviewed six people for the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为这个职位面试了六个人。
senses.why: English turned the noun into a verb without changing its shape.
senses.whyCN: 英语把这个名词直接转成动词，形式不变。

senses.title: A private talk
senses.definition: a formal private meeting between parties who need to exchange views
senses.definitionCN: 需要交换看法者之间的正式私下会面
senses.example: The minister granted an interview to the delegation.
senses.exampleCN: 部长接见了代表团并与之会谈。
senses.why: The word also keeps its neutral sense of two parties meeting to talk.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也保留了「两方会面交谈」这一中性义。

intro.en: Interview joins Latin inter- "between" and videre "to see": a meeting face to face.
intro.cn: interview 把拉丁语 inter-「之间」与 videre「看见」合起来：一次面对面的会面。

items.en: Entreveue in French meant a meeting where people see each other.
items.cn: 法语的 entreveue 指彼此见面的会晤。

items.en: English borrowed interview in the sixteenth century for a formal meeting.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 interview，指正式会晤。

items.en: Newspapers turned the meeting into a published question-and-answer.
items.cn: 报纸把这种会面变成刊登出来的问答。

items.en: Employers borrowed it for judging job candidates.
items.cn: 雇主借用它指对求职者的考察。

items.en: Broadcasting made the interview a household word.
items.cn: 广播电视让 interview 成为家喻户晓的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -view root of seeing; the near-meaning group holds kinds of talk.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -view「看见」词根；近义组收各类谈话。

entries.definition: To look again at something in order to judge.
What can be seen, or an opinion.
The person being asked the questions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「受访者；受面试者」。

entries.definition: An informal talk between people.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「交谈」，语气随意。

entries.definition: A short test performance for a role.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「试演」，偏艺术行当。

entries.definition: A formal session where evidence is heard.

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the face-to-face picture of two people looking at each other.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「两个人面对面看着对方」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus view see equals seeing each other.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 view「看」就是彼此相见。

normal.en: A job interview is a view of you taken from across a desk.
normal.cn: 求职面试就是隔着桌子取你的一张「看法」。

normal.en: The boss interviews; the candidate is interviewed.
normal.cn: 老板面试别人，候选人被面试。

normal.en: Magazines print the interview as questions and answers.
normal.cn: 杂志把采访印成问答。

normal.en: View also lives in review and preview.
normal.cn: view 也活在 review 与 preview 里。

abstract.en: An interview is a short, formal version of being known.
abstract.cn: 面试是「被了解」这件事的简短正式版。

abstract.en: Two strangers look at each other and call it seeing.
abstract.cn: 两个陌生人互相打量，然后管这叫「看见」。

abstract.en: The room is small because the stakes are large.
abstract.cn: 房间很小，是因为赌注很大。

examples.en: He prepared for the interview by reading the company report.
examples.cn: 他为面试做了准备，读了公司的报告。

examples.en: The paper published a rare interview with the coach.
examples.cn: 报纸刊登了这位教练少有的专访。

examples.en: They will interview three more applicants tomorrow.
examples.cn: 他们明天还要面试另外三名申请者。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ view（看）——彼此当着面看一看

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ videre「看见」→ 古法语 entreveue「会面」→ 英语 interview。同族有 interviewer、interviewee、review。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a job interview, a media interview, the verb of asking, and a formal private meeting.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：求职面试、媒体采访、提问这个动作，以及正式私下会晤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs facing each other with nothing but a recorder between.
core.cn: 核心意象：两张面对面的椅子，中间只放一台录音机。

branches.en: THE DESK: an employer weighs a candidate.
branches.cn: 办公桌这条线：雇主掂量候选人。

branches.en: THE MICROPHONE: a journalist gathers words for print.
branches.cn: 话筒这条线：记者为刊登收集话语。

branches.en: THE QUESTION: the act of asking itself.
branches.cn: 问题这条线：提问这个动作。

branches.en: THE DOOR: a formal private meeting of two sides.
branches.cn: 门口这条线：两方的正式私下会面。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are controlled talk with a purpose.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是有目的、被掌控的谈话。

intro.en: Interview is inter- "between" plus the Latin root vid- "see", with the French participle ending.
intro.cn: interview 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁词根 vid-「看见」，词尾来自法语分词。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is recorded, and French entreveue is its medieval meeting form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 有记载，法语 entreveue 是它中世纪的会面形式。

items.exampleCN: 它标出相互之间的位置。

items.example: The root also appears in vision and evident.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 vision 与 evident。

items.example: The verb is the base of the root.
The French noun is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语名词是直接来源。

items.example: It forms review, to see again.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 review，意为再看一次。

items.example: It forms preview, to see beforehand.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 preview，意为预先看到。

definition_zh: 低的；矮的；低落的；低声的；低点；低水平
definition_en: not high or tall; below the usual level, amount or value; also sad, quiet or deep in sound, and a lowest point
core_image: 一只手掌压向地面，把一根横杆缓缓降到几乎贴着泥土的位置
scene: 傍晚的球场边，一个孩子把球贴着草地滚出去，球一路几乎不离开泥土。 The ball stayed low and skimmed over the wet grass.
sceneCN: 这里 low 是「低的、贴近地面的」（第 1 个义项：高度低）；句意为球一直贴着地面，从湿草上滑过去。画面里可认出球场边、草地与滚动的球。

pos.zh: 低的；矮的；低落的；低声的

derivatives.zh: low 的比较级形式兼作动词，义为「降低；放下」
由 low 加形容词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「卑微的；地位低的」
由前缀 be- 与 low 构成，义为「在……下面；低于」
由 low 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「低；低落」

senses.title: Not high in height or position
senses.definition: having a small distance from the top to the ground, or standing near the ground
senses.definitionCN: 从顶部到地面的距离小，或位置接近地面的
senses.example: The shelf is low enough for a child to reach.
senses.exampleCN: 这个架子很低，孩子够得着。
senses.why: The oldest use describes a body or object near the ground, so lowness begins as a physical distance rather than a value.
senses.whyCN: 最早的用法描述人或物贴近地面的位置，所以「低」首先是一种空间距离，而不是价值判断。

senses.title: Below the usual level or amount
senses.definition: less than the normal, expected or average amount, level or value
senses.definitionCN: 低于正常、预期或平均的数量、水平或数值
senses.example: The river is unusually low this summer.
senses.exampleCN: 今年夏天这条河的水位异常低。
senses.why: Once the word can measure height, it can measure any scale, so a low river or a low price simply sits far down its own scale.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词能度量高度，就能度量任何尺度，于是低水位、低价格只是在自己的尺度上位置很靠下。

senses.title: Sad, weak or without energy
senses.definition: feeling unhappy, tired or without hope and energy
senses.definitionCN: 感到不快、疲惫，或缺少希望与精力
senses.example: He felt low for weeks after moving to the new city.
senses.exampleCN: 搬到新城市后，他情绪低落了几个星期。
senses.why: A low position is close to the ground, and English links that downward picture with a lowered spirit, so the word moves from space to mood.
senses.whyCN: 低的位置贴近地面，英语把这幅向下的画面与低落的精神联系起来，于是词义从空间转到情绪。

senses.title: Soft in volume or deep in pitch
senses.definition: produced quietly, or having a deep pitch rather than a high one
senses.definitionCN: 以较小的音量发出，或音调低沉而不高尖的
senses.example: She answered in a low voice so the others would not hear.
senses.exampleCN: 她低声回答，免得别人听见。
senses.why: A deep note sits at the bottom of the scale and a quiet voice carries less force, so both are heard as a kind of downward position.
senses.whyCN: 低沉的音处在音阶底部，轻声说话的力量也更小，两者听起来都像一种向下的位置。

senses.title: A low point, level or area
senses.definition: a point or level that is the lowest reached, or an area of low pressure in weather
senses.definitionCN: 所达到的最低点或最低水平，也指天气图上气压较低的区域
senses.example: Sales reached a new low in the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季销售额跌到了新的低点。
senses.why: Because the adjective can measure any scale, English turns it into a noun for the bottom value itself, and weather writers use it for low pressure.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个形容词能度量各种尺度，英语就把它变成名词，指最低的那个数值本身，气象作者又用它指低气压。

intro.en: Low is an Old English adjective for being near the ground; it later spread from height to amounts, mood and sound.
intro.cn: low 是古英语中表示贴近地面的形容词，后来从高度扩展到数量、情绪与声音。

items.en: The adjective lāh meant low or humble, and it could describe both the ground and a person's rank.
items.cn: 形容词 lāh 意为低的、卑微的，既能形容地面，也能形容人的地位。

items.en: The reconstructed form is lauha-, rebuilt from related Germanic words such as Dutch laag.
items.cn: 其重构形式为 lauha-，是通过荷兰语 laag 等相关日耳曼词重建出来的。

items.en: Middle English lowe kept the physical sense and began to describe prices, voices and spirits.
items.cn: 中古英语的 lowe 保留物理义，并开始形容价格、嗓音与情绪。

items.en: Writers extended the word to any scale that could be measured, from income to temperature.
items.cn: 作家把这个词扩展到任何可度量的尺度，从收入到温度。

items.en: Modern English uses low for height, level, mood and voice, and as a noun for the lowest point.
items.cn: 现代英语用 low 指高度、水平、情绪与嗓音，也用作名词指最低点。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the low family and a spelling neighbour; the near-meaning group collects words for small height, small depth and low rank.
note.cn: 形近组收 low 词族与一个拼写相近的词；近义组收表示高度小、深度小与地位低的词。

entries.definition: The comparative of low, also a verb meaning to bring down.
entries.definitionCN: low 的比较级，也可作动词表示降低。

entries.definition: Humble in rank or position; built from low with -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 地位或身份卑微的；由 low 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: Under or lower than something, built with be- and low.
entries.definitionCN: 在……下面或低于某物，由 be- 与 low 构成。

entries.definition: Not fast; only the spelling and rhyme are close, and the origin is different.
entries.definitionCN: 缓慢的；只是拼写与读音和 low 相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: Having little height when said of a person or thing.
entries.definitionCN: 形容人或物时表示个子矮、高度小。

entries.definition: Not deep, with little distance from top to bottom.
entries.definitionCN: 不深的，从顶到底距离很小。

entries.definition: Low in rank or importance, without pride.
entries.definitionCN: 地位或重要性低，不骄傲。

entries.definition: Making little or no sound.
entries.definitionCN: 发出很少声音或没有声音的。

entries.definition: Going far down from the top or surface.
entries.definitionCN: 从顶部或表面向下延伸很深的。

normalIntro.en: The word has been about being near the ground since Old English, and its family keeps returning to downward position, lower value and lowered feeling.
normalIntro.cn: 自古英语起这个词就表示贴近地面，同族词反复回到向下的位置、更低的值与低落的情绪。

normal.en: Old English lāh already meant low, so the word has kept its shape and sense for a very long time.
normal.cn: 古英语 lāh 已经表示低，所以这个词的形态与含义都保持了很长时间。

normal.en: The comparative is lower and the superlative is lowest, both made with the regular endings.
normal.cn: 比较级是 lower，最高级是 lowest，都用规则词尾构成。

normal.en: Below is be- plus low, literally at a lower place than something.
normal.cn: below 是 be- 加 low，字面就是「处于比某物更低的位置」。

normal.en: Low season names the quiet months of a trade, when prices and crowds are at their lowest.
normal.cn: low season 指行业的淡季，此时价格与客流都处在最低。

normal.en: Low point is a fixed phrase for the worst or weakest moment of a period.
normal.cn: low point 是固定说法，指一段时期里最糟或最弱的时刻。

abstract.en: A word that starts as a measurement of height ends up measuring mood, price and sound, because English reads downward as less.
abstract.cn: 一个从高度测量开始的词，最后用来测量情绪、价格与声音，因为英语把「向下」读作「更少」。

abstract.en: The same low note and low mood share a shape: both are felt as sinking rather than rising.
abstract.cn: 低沉的音与低落的情绪共享一种形状：两者都被感觉为下沉而不是上升。

abstract.en: A low point is only meaningful against a scale, which is why the word always implies something higher above it.
abstract.cn: 低点只有相对某个尺度才有意义，所以这个词总暗示着上方还有更高的东西。

examples.en: The shelf is low enough for a child to reach.
examples.cn: 这个架子很低，孩子够得着。

examples.en: The river is unusually low this summer.
examples.cn: 今年夏天这条河的水位异常低。

examples.en: She answered in a low voice so the others would not hear.
examples.cn: 她低声回答，免得别人听见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「漏」——水往低处漏，位置越来越低，记住 low 是低。

root: 古英语 lāh（低的、卑微的），一般认为来自原始日耳曼语 lauha-，与荷兰语 laag 同源；没有可靠的拉丁同族词。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is a position near the ground; the senses then measure level, mood, sound and finally the lowest point itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是贴近地面的位置；义项随后度量水平、情绪、声音，最后指最低点本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pressing a bar down until it almost touches the soil.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掌把一根横杆压到几乎贴着泥土的位置。

branches.en: a child rolling a ball along the grass
branches.cn: 孩子让球贴着草地滚动

branches.en: a river running far below its banks
branches.cn: 河水远低于河岸

branches.en: a newcomer alone in a rented room
branches.cn: 新来的人独坐在租来的房间里

branches.en: a whisper meant for one pair of ears
branches.cn: 只说给一双耳朵听的耳语

branches.en: a chart line falling to its worst value
branches.cn: 图表曲线跌到最差的数值

intro.en: Low is a short Germanic adjective that English has turned into comparison, a verb, a compound and a noun.
intro.cn: low 是一个简短的日耳曼语形容词，英语把它发展出比较级、动词、复合词与名词用法。

latinIntro.en: Low belongs to the Germanic family, so it has no reliable Latin cognate.
latinIntro.cn: low 属于日耳曼语族，因此没有可靠的拉丁同族词。

items.example: Old English lāh described both the ground and a person's rank.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 lāh 既形容地面，也形容人的地位。

items.meaning: near the ground or below a level
items.example: The wall was low enough to look over.
items.exampleCN: 这堵墙低得可以越过它看过去。

items.meaning: more low; also to bring down
items.example: The sun sank lower behind the hills.
The lake reaches its lowest level in autumn.
items.exampleCN: 湖泊在秋天达到最低水位。

items.example: He came from a lowly family but rose quickly.
items.exampleCN: 他出身卑微，却升得很快。

items.example: The valley lay below the clouds.

items.meaningCN: 形容词后缀：具有……性质的

items.meaning: the quiet period of a trade
items.example: Hotels cut prices in the low season.

definition_zh: 平底锅；锅；盘子；用于构成复合词表示器具
definition_en: a wide, shallow metal container with a handle, used for cooking food
core_image: 一柄宽扁的铁盘，架在火上把食物摊平煎熟
scene: 周末清晨的厨房里飘着香气，妈妈在灶前忙碌。 She cracked two eggs into a hot pan and listened to them sizzle.
sceneCN: 这里 pan 是「平底锅」（第 1 个义项：烹调用的宽浅金属容器）；句意是她把两个鸡蛋磕进热平底锅里，听着滋滋作响。

pos.zh: 用平底锅烹调；（在淘金盘中）淘洗

collocations.phrase: bake the cake in a pan
clean the pan with a sponge

derivatives.zh: 由 sauce（调味汁）加 pan 构成，义为「炖锅；深平底锅」
由 fry（煎炸）加 pan 构成，义为「煎锅」
由 pan 加 cake 构成，义为「薄煎饼」，因在平锅中摊开煎制而得名

senses.title: A shallow cooking vessel
senses.definition: a wide, shallow metal container with a long handle, used for frying or cooking
senses.definitionCN: 带长柄的宽浅金属容器，用来煎炸或烹煮食物
senses.example: Heat the oil in a large pan before adding the onions.
senses.exampleCN: 先把油倒进大平底锅烧热，再放洋葱。
senses.why: The core image is a flat metal dish over fire; everyday cooking made this the most basic sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是架在火上的宽浅金属盘，日常烹调使它成为最基础的义项。

senses.title: A similar container of any kind
senses.definition: any similar open container, such as a dish used for baking or measuring
senses.definitionCN: 任何类似的敞口容器，如用于烘烤或称量的盘皿
senses.example: Press the dough evenly across the baking pan.
senses.exampleCN: 把面团均匀地压进烤盘里。
senses.why: The flat, open shape extends from cooking pots to any wide dish that holds things.
senses.whyCN: 宽扁敞口的形状从烹调锅具延伸到任何盛放东西的宽浅盘皿。

senses.title: To pan for gold
senses.definition: to wash gravel in a pan in order to find gold or other minerals
senses.definitionCN: 把砂砾放进淘盘中用水洗涤，以寻找金子等矿物
senses.example: Many prospectors panned the rivers of California in the gold rush.
senses.exampleCN: 淘金潮中许多探矿者在加利福尼亚的河流里淘洗砂金。
senses.why: The pan is both the tool and the action of swirling it to separate gold from gravel.
senses.whyCN: 淘盘既是工具，也指摇动淘盘把金子从砂砾中分离出来的动作。

senses.title: To criticize harshly
senses.definition: to criticize a film, book, or performance very severely
senses.definitionCN: 对电影、书籍或演出进行非常严厉的批评
senses.example: Critics panned the film for its weak plot.
senses.exampleCN: 影评人猛烈批评这部电影情节薄弱。
senses.why: This sense extends the idea of "flattening" something under a blow, like pounding it flat in a pan.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项把「拍扁打平」的画面延伸开来，像在锅里把东西压平一样把作品贬得一无是处。

senses.title: A wide natural hollow
senses.definition: a wide, shallow natural hollow in the ground, especially one that holds water or salt
senses.definitionCN: 地面上宽而浅的自然洼地，尤指存水或存盐的地方
senses.example: Salt is collected from the shallow pans along the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 盐从沿海的浅盐滩中采集而来。
senses.why: The shallow, basin-like shape of the pan is applied to flat natural depressions.
senses.whyCN: 浅盆般的形状被借用来指平坦的天然洼陷地形。

intro.en: Pan is one of the oldest household words in English, tracing back to a common Germanic word for a flat vessel.
intro.cn: pan 是英语中最古老的家用词之一，可追溯到日耳曼语族中表示扁平器皿的同一词源。

items.en: panne meant a pan or a flat vessel for cooking.
items.cn: 古英语 panne 意为平底锅或烹调用的扁平器皿。

items.en: The word comes from a common Germanic root *panno, meaning a flat vessel.
items.cn: 该词来自日耳曼语共同词根 *panno，意为扁平器皿（重构形式）。

items.en: Old Norse panna is a close cognate, suggesting a shared northern European borrowing.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 panna 是密切的同源词，表明这是北欧的共同借词或共同遗产。

items.en: It is generally held to be related to Latin patina, a broad shallow dish, which itself came from Greek.
items.cn: 一般认为它与拉丁语 patina（宽浅盘皿）相关，而 patina 又源自希腊语。

items.en: The word stayed in continuous use for cooking vessels across the medieval period.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，该词持续用于指称烹调器皿。

items.en: Compound words such as frying pan and saucepan, and verbs like pan for gold, developed in the modern period.
items.cn: 现代英语发展出 frying pan、saucepan 等复合词，以及 pan for gold 这类动词用法。

note.en: Pan sits in a family of everyday vessels and compounds; the words below are easily confused or closely related.
note.cn: pan 处于日常器皿词与复合词家族中，下列词容易混淆或关系密切。

entries.definition: a deep round container for cooking, deeper than a pan
entries.definitionCN: 深圆烹调容器，比 pan 深；两者同属炊具但形状不同

entries.definition: a deep pan with a handle, used for sauces and boiling
entries.definitionCN: 有柄的深锅，用于煮酱汁；由 sauce 加 pan 构成

entries.definition: a flat pan with a long handle for frying food
entries.definitionCN: 长柄平底的煎锅；pan 的最常见复合词

entries.definition: a thin pointed piece of metal, only one letter away from pan
entries.definitionCN: 大头针；与 pan 仅一字母之差，拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a shallow container for serving or baking food
entries.definitionCN: 浅口盛器，用于上菜或烘烤；与 pan 的器皿义相邻

entries.definition: a flat board or shallow container for carrying things
entries.definitionCN: 托盘；形状同为宽浅，但通常不带柄不直接加热

entries.definition: a deep round-bottomed Chinese cooking pan
entries.definitionCN: 中式圆底炒锅；同为烹调锅具，形制不同

entries.definition: a container with a lid and spout, used for boiling water
entries.definitionCN: 水壶；同为厨房金属器具，专用于烧水

normalIntro.en: Use the root shape and real compounds to fix the word in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 利用形状意象和真实复合词来锁定这个词。

normal.en: Pan sounds like the Chinese word "pen" (pen2), which also means a wide, shallow container.
normal.cn: pan 的发音与中文「盆（pén）」相近，两者都是宽浅容器，音义双关便于记忆。

normal.en: frying pan = fry + pan, the pan you fry things in.
normal.cn: frying pan 即「煎锅」，由 fry 加 pan 构成，记复合词顺带记住本词。

normal.en: saucepan = sauce + pan, a deeper pan for sauces.
normal.cn: saucepan 即「炖锅」，由 sauce 加 pan 构成，与煎锅形成深浅对照。

normal.en: pancake = pan + cake, a cake cooked flat in a pan.
normal.cn: pancake 即「薄煎饼」，pan 加 cake，锅煎的饼。

normal.en: pan for gold: swirl the pan, the gold stays, the gravel washes away.
normal.cn: pan for gold 淘金：摇动淘盘，金子留下，砂砾被水冲走。

abstract.en: Picture a flat iron disc with a long handle glowing over the fire.
abstract.cn: 想象一只带长柄的扁铁盘在火上发亮，这就是 pan 的核心画面。

abstract.en: Critics pan a movie: they flatten it like a pancake.
abstract.cn: 影评人 pan 一部电影：像摊煎饼一样把它压扁贬低。

abstract.en: A salt pan in the desert: a shallow basin where water evaporates.
abstract.cn: 沙漠中的盐沼：浅浅的盆状洼地，水分蒸发后留下盐。

examples.en: She cracked two eggs into a hot pan and listened to them sizzle.
examples.cn: 她把两个鸡蛋磕进热平底锅里，听着滋滋作响。

examples.en: Gold prospectors panned the river in search of a fortune.
examples.cn: 淘金者在河里淘洗砂砾，希望寻得财富。

examples.en: Critics panned the play, but audiences loved it.
examples.cn: 评论家对这部戏大加批评，观众却很喜欢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盘」——pan 谐音「盘」，平底锅正是一只浅浅的盘子架在火上；淘金的人端着「盘」在水里摇，影评人把烂片「盘」得体无完肤。

root: pan 来自古英语 panne，可追溯至日耳曼共同词根 *panno（重构形式），一般认为与拉丁语 patina（宽浅盘皿）相关，而 patina 源自希腊语；属于英语中存续最久的器皿词之一。

sensesIntro.en: From the basic cooking vessel, pan spreads to any wide shallow container, then to the verb of panning for gold, the critical sense of panning a film, and flat natural basins.
sensesIntro.cn: 从基本的烹调用具出发，pan 先扩展到各类宽浅盘皿，再延伸为淘金动词、影评论动词，以及盆状地形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide, shallow handled vessel over fire
core.cn: 核心意象：架在火上的宽浅带柄盘皿

branches.en: The basic frying vessel
branches.cn: 基本的煎炒锅具

branches.en: Any wide open container for holding things
branches.cn: 各类宽浅敞口容器

branches.en: Swirling gravel in the pan to wash out gold
branches.cn: 摇盘淘洗砂金

branches.en: Flattening a work by harsh criticism
branches.cn: 以严厉批评把作品压扁

branches.en: Shallow basin-shaped hollows in the land
branches.cn: 盆状的天然浅洼地

intro.en: Pan rarely stands alone in formation; it is best learned through its compounds and set phrases.
intro.cn: pan 很少单独参与构词，最有效的学习途径是它的复合词与固定短语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cognate patina gave English panning-like dish words and the colour word patina.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词 patina 派生出英语中与盘皿相关的词，还有表示「铜绿；光润表面」的 patina。

items.example: Heat the frying pan until it smokes lightly.
items.exampleCN: 把煎锅加热到微微冒烟。

items.example: Boil the pasta in a large saucepan.

items.meaning: a flat cake fried in a pan
items.example: We ate pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
items.exampleCN: 早餐我们吃了配枫糖浆的薄煎饼。

items.meaning: to turn out well; to succeed
items.example: The investment did not pan out in the end.
items.exampleCN: 这项投资最终没有成功。

items.meaning: to wash gravel for gold in a pan
items.example: Tourists still pan for gold in those streams.
items.exampleCN: 游客们仍在那些溪流里淘金。

items.meaning: a metal pan for holding burning fuel
items.example: The camper set the fire pan on stones.
items.exampleCN: 露营者把火盆放在石头上。

items.meaning: a pan used in an oven
items.example: Grease the baking pan before pouring in the batter.
items.exampleCN: 倒入面糊前先给烤盘抹油。

items.meaning: a shallow basin where salt is harvested
items.example: Workers walked across the salt pan at dawn.

items.meaning: a surface film; a superficial polish
items.example: The bronze statue has a green patina.
items.exampleCN: 青铜雕像上覆着绿色铜绿。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 宽浅盘皿；一般认为与 pan 同源
